headline: Connect 3 Day Blinds through Motionblinds
intro: Home Assistant lists 3 Day Blinds as a virtual integration supported by Motionblinds. The pinned component contains only its manifest, which points setup and device support to the Motionblinds integration.
highlights: The 3 Day Blinds manifest declares the integration type as virtual
Its supported_by field points to the motion_blinds integration, rather than defining a separate setup flow here
The Motionblinds integration provides cover entities for recognized blind types, including shades, shutters, curtains, and awnings
